prompt: It worked yesterday, so he looks at what was merged since then.
why: If it used to work, the change is the prime suspect.
trap: Narrowing could follow, but start with the changes.

prompt: The app broke right after a library update.
why: Look at what changed: the update.
trap: It isn't another machine; it's a recent change.

prompt: Undoing the last deploy makes the error stop, confirming the cause.
why: Rolling back a change tests whether it caused the bug.
trap: It's one change, but the clue is it was the latest.

prompt: She compares the working version with the broken one line by line.
tells: compares the working version with the broken one
why: Comparing before and after finds what changed.
trap: It narrows things, but by looking at the change.

prompt: Someone edited a setting this morning, and that's when errors started.
why: Timing of the change points to the cause.
trap: It's configuration, but the clue is the recent change.

prompt: Nothing in the code changed, but a new kind of order started arriving today.
tells: a new kind of order started arriving today
why: Something did change: the data. Ask what changed, not just the code.
trap: It is bad input too, but the clue is 'what changed today'.
